# Rose, Figueroa & Associates

Rose, Figueroa & Associates is a tax and accounting firm in Sherman Oaks, California.
Dennis F. Rose, CPA, has served clients since 1977. Alex Figueroa, CPA, is his partner.
They prepare individual and business tax returns.
They plan taxes to lower what business owners owe.
They resolve IRS problems such as audits, back taxes, and liens.
They handle bookkeeping, payroll, and controller work for small businesses.
They set up and teach QuickBooks Desktop and Online.
The office is at 15490 Ventura Boulevard, Suite 220, Sherman Oaks, CA 91403.
Hours are Monday through Friday, 9 to 5.
Call (818) 501-7788 or email info@rfcpa.la for a free consultation.
Website: https://www.rfcpa.la/
